A.method: Claude Code agent, pass A: searched each paper for the question's metric and dataset terms, then read the matching table or sentence in the pypdf page text (docs/AGENT_EXTRACTION.md).

tabr_average_rank.reason: Table 3 (single models on the default benchmark), column 'Avg. Rank'. Other values: 1.3± 0.9 (ensembles vs GBDT, Table 4), 1.2± 0.6 (Table 11).

ft_transformer_average_rank.reason: FT-Transformer occurs only in the introduction (page 1) and in its hyperparameter space (appendix D.10, page 23); no table reports an average rank for it.

xgboost_average_rank.reason: XGBoost appears only in the comparison of ensembles with GBDT. Table 4, tuned hyperparameters, column 'Avg. Rank'. Other values: 3.4± 0.9 (default, Table 4), 1.9± 0.7 (Table 11).

B.method: Claude Code agent, pass B, made after pass A in the same session (NOT independent of A): searched each paper again from the start, first for the row or sentence that names the model, then for the column or value. Each re-search confirmed A's answer, so B's values, units, and pages were taken over from A; B's quotes (whole rows) and reasons were copied again from the pypdf page text (docs/AGENT_EXTRACTION.md, section 3).

tabr_average_rank.reason: Row TabR of Table 3 (single models), last column 'Avg. Rank'. Also printed: 1.3± 0.9 (Table 4, ensembles) and 1.2± 0.6 (Table 11).

ft_transformer_average_rank.reason: No row for FT-Transformer in any table; the name occurs only on page 1 and in appendix D.10 (hyperparameters, page 23).

xgboost_average_rank.reason: XGBoost has no row in Table 3; Table 4 (ensembles vs GBDT), tuned XGBoost row, last column 'Avg. Rank'. Also printed: 3.4± 0.9 (default) and 1.9± 0.7 (Table 11). Ranks are relative to each table's set of models.
